verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking opt-out is a fair privacy question for a developer platform that ships SDKs, a CLI and an MCP server, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents any way to opt out of telemetry or usage tracking. The CLI and MCP probes only confirm those tools exist and say nothing about their telemetry behavior.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
